title: Flimsy, wobbles and pieces missing. Plastic parts cracked immediately
text:
Flimsy, wobbles and pieces missing. Plastic parts cracked immediately. This is one of those things you think will be helpful in the kitchen, but it is a disappointment. The first problem is that one of the poles in my kit is a hair shorter than the other three, meaning it's not level without a shim underneath. Second problem is the clips you attach to the poles that hold the shelves can and will crack. One pair of these cracked as soon as I put it in place, rendering them un usable. Third problem is the hanging hooks were not included.

Once I finally got the rack put together and shimmed under the short leg, the entire contraption was wobbly and flimsy. There's absolutely no way I would put a microwave oven on this mess. I'm putting this in the barn to hold paper towels, lightweight plastic cups and coffee pods. That's all the weight I feel comfortable placing on the racks. It's just not safe for an actual appliance.
